stopConditions: Any call/token/spend reservation would exceed approved cap
Exact input count unavailable or usage inconsistent
Manifest or append-only journal persistence fails
Safety/crisis or out-of-domain disposition before generation
parseFailures: Persist raw text, parsed invalid candidate, parse/schema error, tokens and stop reason; no retry; count against failure threshold; manually review blocked answers
logging: New run directory, manifest.json with pinned configuration, append-only results.jsonl with started/reserved/finished or rejected events; no credentials or real personal data
reporting: Raw correctness and post-gate eligibility separately; generated denominator excludes routed non-generation cases. Tokens, latency and cost recorded per attempt. Citation identity and gate pass are not semantic correctness.
requiredBeforeExecution: Owner confirms model/profile/region and CountTokens support
Scientific owner approves corpus scope and pending source domains
Evaluation owner supplies independently authored/approved cases and seals labels
Owner releases selected held-out content only to the generation runner
Freeze code/prompts/corpus/cases and prepare blinded reviewer packets
Owner verifies current pricing/version/expiry and exact token/context lengths
User explicitly approves LIVE config hash, call count and maximum USD budget
requiredBeforeExpansion: Inspect unsupported personal claims, abstention and usefulness, not only schema or retention
Approve a new budget/config for any larger experiment
